boundary_checks: Fullwidth folding occurs only in the parse copy after the raw token is anchored; raw value/quote/spans are unchanged.
Explicit half-proportion operands use existing PROPORTION with finite calculation/payment tails and explicit operators; no multiplication is performed.
Postposed negative annotation uses finite anchored words and finite record/amount tails; it returns unsupported, never a derived signed amount.

Finite payment instruction digit-tail exception requires a complete currency unit and the same right boundary in whole value, quote and complete source layout; a local quote cannot discard a following question mark.
Unchanged source review supplies complete layout edges to the updated shared helper.
Different sentence/person, real fractional currency continuation, true rate/unknown, same-value different-event and no historical amount upgrade are covered by locked independent tests.
limitations: Finite grammar only; no claim of arbitrary Chinese segmentation, all natural-language money expressions, or legal correctness.
Candidate acceptance does not mean amount availability or calculation authorization.
Independent work did not execute parent fullcheck, HTTP, remote CI, or human acceptance.
